S&P 500 point-in-time members · full record 1998–2026 · 300 scenarios = buy depth × sell rule × annual contribution × lot size, each a complete simulation · identical cashflows into every leg · Sharadar as-reported fundamentals · no Stage-2 judgment.

Live config = bottom 5% + TRIM s95 + live $1k lots. "hold" = no sells ever. Lot size is the capacity knob: at the fixed live $1,000 the multiple decays as contributions rise (the ladder cannot deploy the flow), while a lot sized as a constant fraction of the annual contribution holds the same multiple at every funding level. Benchmarks (EW members incl. delisted, SPY, BRK.B) receive the identical contributions as the funnel in every scenario. Dashed line = cumulative dollars contributed.
